main.description: Stream the calling account's cluster state as an atproto event stream (binary WebSocket frames, each a DRISL-CBOR header then a DRISL-CBOR payload). Authenticate on the upgrade request with the normal service-auth token (Authorization: Bearer, lxm = this method). The account comes from the verified token's iss only. The token is verified once, at connect; a healthy stream is not cut when the token's exp passes. The stream ends when the client closes, when the gateway restarts, or at the gateway's stream lifetime bound (1 h by default) with a TokenExpired error frame; reconnect with a fresh token. There is no seq and no cursor: every connect starts with a snapshot (one #cluster message per matching cluster, one #member per control-plane member, one #nodeClaim per NodeClaim, each with snapshot=true), then one #info named SnapshotComplete, then live changes read from kcp watches.

name.description: Only this cluster. Unknown name: ClusterNotFound error frame, then close. Absent: every cluster of the account, including clusters created while the stream is open.

errors.name: Unauthorized
errors.description: Missing or invalid service-auth token, or its aud or lxm is not this service or method.

errors.name: TokenExpired
errors.description: The token was expired at connect, or the stream reached the gateway's lifetime bound. Get a fresh token and reconnect.

errors.name: ClusterNotFound
errors.description: The named cluster does not exist, was deleted while the stream was open, or the account has no clusters yet (call createCluster first).

errors.name: IdentityRevoked
errors.description: The account's identity is revoked; the caller lost access.

errors.name: ClusterUnavailable
errors.description: The gateway could not read or watch its kcp.

errors.name: ConsumerTooSlow
errors.description: The client did not read frames fast enough.

server.description: status.URL. Absent until the apiserver has answered once.

reason.description: The reason of the condition that explains the phase (Ready, or IdentityVerificationFailed or TeardownBlocked when true).

message.description: That condition's message; names the members that are not running when the phase is Initializing.

snapshot.description: Sent as part of the connect snapshot, not as a change.

time.description: When the gateway saw this state.

member.description: The control-plane member (postgres, openbao, kine, k3s, ...), read from its HostProcess, Postgres or OpenBaoServer object. Members start one after another.

reason.description: Why the member was lost, when it was.

message.description: Why the claim is in its phase; carries the provision failure.

bidder.description: The DID of the winning bidder.
